description: Write the last N messages of a Claude Code session to ~/.claude/bridge-context.md and ~/Documents/claude-bridge-context.md as formatted markdown. If session_id is omitted, uses the most recently updated session. Designed to pair with a Google Drive-synced ~/Documents so Projects Claude can read live Claude Code output via its Drive connector.

last_n.description: Number of most recent messages to include (default 20).

session_id.description: Optional session id. Defaults to the most recently modified session.

name: write_context
